about: which knob combinations build, per phone, and the Apple guideline limits every build is checked against. blender/case.py reads the knob defaults here; its asserts are the same rules; ./build skips what these rules out and fails on anything else. ADG = Accessory Design Guidelines (extract/pdf/adg.pdf).

KEYS.values: button names; names a phone lacks are dropped

CLOSED.values: button names, none shared with KEYS

BACK_BAND.values: null (full back) or mm of back kept round the edge

COUPON.values: null or mm of each edge kept round the bottom-right corner

combinations.why: the slider covers a fitted window
slider rails reach y -52, a charger's top edge is at -45
magnets and the charger need the full back
the plate sits in a banded back
corner walls leave no wall for a key
a button is either a key or covered

phones.test: ref/iphone/sizes.json entry has a corner list (or a full spec)

phones.why: full-width camera plateau, use CAMERA universal
phones.test: sizes.json camera plateau is not a bounded outline

phones.why: right rail falls off the case
phones.test: slider right edge + SL_CLR + RAIL_W <= W + CLEAR + WALL, the rails clear of every lens and flash cone at their depth

phones.why: cigarette clip runs off the bottom
camera reaches past the universal window

limits.rule: exposed glass to any flat surface the case rests on
limits.case: GLASS_GAP 1.0; rim PROUD 1.0 over the front glass, camera ring 1.0 past the lens cover
limits.checked: check(): front glass, lens cover and back glass points against the convex hull, every build

limits.rule: case thickness on the back of the phone
limits.source: sheet note 8 on every iPhone drawing (SE: 5.0)

limits.rule: case wall below the phone, for docks and cables
MagSafe magnet to the case outside
limits.case: MS_FLOOR 0.85, magnet 0.55 thick, 0.55 from the device

limits.rule: lens and flash light cones clear of the case
limits.source: ADG 5.7.1 and each sheet's keepout cones
limits.case: every cone cut through the case, grown by CLEAR for the phone's shift
limits.checked: the cut is part of every build

limits.rule: USB-C recommended connector keepout, flush to the product surface, 14.0 outward
limits.case: obround keepout grown by CLEAR, through the bottom wall
limits.checked: the cut is part of every build

limits.case: PORT_OFFSET 2.0 past the port edge, 45 deg outside chamfer, PORT_LAND 0.6 straight wall (1.5 max)
limits.checked: the cut is part of every build

limits.rule: rim lip over the rolled front edge clear of the glass edge
limits.case: LIP 0.5, and LIP > CLEAR so the phone is retained
